description: This file appears to be a JavaScript module defining constants, variables, and functions related to testing channel path configurations and test file inclusion/exclusion patterns in a project that uses different channels (e.g., discord, slack). It manages test file sets, test roots, and filtering logic for test file discovery, especially with regard to extensions and overrides.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to use forward slashes regardless of OS-specific path separator.

methods.name: isChannelSurfaceTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file path is a channel surface test file based on test root prefixes and extension routing.
